title: Navigating Nice’s Belle Epoque: A Guide to the UNESCO Heritage City
creator: Jeanne Oliver
description: A walk from the opera house along the Promenade des Anglais, past the palace hotels and the Albert I garden, into the Carré d’Or, the neighborhood of villas and churches built when Nice became a winter resort.

title: The Best of Nice’s Old Town: Highlights, Legends and Secret Spots
creator: Jeanne Oliver
description: A walk down Rue Droite, one of the oldest streets in Nice, past the Baroque Palais Lascaris and the old Jewish quarter to the Cours Saleya market, ending at a bell tower you can climb.

title: Nice Walking Tour: Historical Highlights from Vieux Nice to Castle Hill
creator: Riviera Bar Crawl Tours
description: A walk from Place Masséna through the flower market, past the cathedral on Place Rossetti, and along the seafront, then up Castle Hill for the view over the Bay of Angels.
